purpose: Retrospective measured-water-to-wheat-yield component feasibility; not an early cover-planting forecast
weather_window: Exact wheat sowing through harvest inclusive; no interpolation or window search

cohorts.main: Observed finite nonnegative water and yield, verified completed harvest
cohorts.nitrate_common: Subset of main with observed nitrate; all compared models rerun on these same 86 rows
cohorts.paired: Observed cover and unique fallow control matched on trial/block/tillage/cycle; controls may be reused

validation: Leave one harvest season out; historical cross-season validation may use later seasons in training. Not a prospective or untouched final test. Repeated plots may recur across seasons; no unseen-plot claim.
preprocessing: StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True) fitted only within each training fold; no imputation or target transformation
management_adjustment: None in this initial ablation; retain trial, tillage, planting window and cover mix for error slices. Associations are not causal water effects.

metrics.primary: Unweighted mean of five held-out season MAEs in t/ha

interpretation: Report water+weather minus weather MAE and seasons improved, nitrate sensitivity and uncertainty. Five seasons cannot establish a reliable effect or farmer-use threshold. No automatic selection or promotion; no tuning after seeing results.
paired_next_phase: Evaluate delta yield separately against zero and training-mean difference baselines; do not assume absolute-yield accuracy validates cover-versus-fallow ranking.
restrictions: No IDs, yield-derived variables, revenue or stability predictors
0-90 cm stored water is not verified PAW
Nitrate follows released 0-30 cm definition; older article mentions 0-15 cm, unresolved
Observed sowing water and realized subsequent weather are unavailable at earlier cover planting
No refit for serving, payload changes or deployment
